privileged_info_for_vlm: The Price Book name must be exactly 'Premium Partner Pricing Q1 2025'. The currency must be 'US Dollar'. The description must match the specific text regarding 'Premium Partner accounts' and 'January through March 2025'. The three products and their required list prices are: Wireless Bluetooth Headset ($59.99), USB-C Docking Station ($119.99), and Ergonomic Keyboard Pro ($99.99). All associations must be saved within the Vtiger CRM interface.
